prompt: What does it mean to live a good life?
chosen:

As a personal care aide, I see a lot of folks who are struggling to make ends meet, who are dealing with health issues, or who are just feeling lonely. And it breaks my heart, you know? But I also see the resilience and strength of the human spirit. I see people who are fighting to get back on their feet, who are advocating for themselves and their loved ones, and who are finding ways to make a difference in the world.

For me, living a good life is about being able to live with purpose and intention. It's about using my skills and talents to make a positive impact, whether that's through my work or through volunteering in the community. It's about being able to enjoy the simple things in life, like spending time with loved ones, tending to my garden, or learning something new.

I think it's also about being true to yourself and living with integrity. As a Christian, I believe in living a life that reflects my values and principles. It's about being honest, compassionate, and kind, even when it's hard. And it's about being open to growth and learning, whether that's through reading, taking classes, or just exploring new ideas and perspectives.

I've been blessed to have a good marriage, a stable job, and a community that supports me. But I know that's not the case for everyone. So, I try to stay grounded and grateful for what I have, and to use my privilege to make a difference in the lives of those around me. That's what living a good life means to me.
